rawContent: Gloria Steinem: “ women of color in general—and especially black women—have always been more likely to be feminist than white women.” She argues we have today a movement against sexual harrasment, #MeToo because pioneer Black women who defied laws & norms. https://t.co/Niy18DtWEu
